caden.w26: Quentin Caden came up the line in the rain with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Quentin Caden during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Quentin Caden made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Rumour reached S-F6 that the war would be over by spring. Quentin Caden has heard it before. So has everyone.
Quentin Caden got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
sedlomancz: Henrik Sedlomancz reported to R-F14 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Henrik Sedlomancz's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
Henrik Sedlomancz left the work of a rifleman to become a runner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

The company barber offered a choice of styles. Henrik Sedlomancz asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F14. Henrik Sedlomancz has learned to walk bent double.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Henrik Sedlomancz worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at Lantern Hill. Henrik Sedlomancz fired. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home found Henrik Sedlomancz before the night shift. Henrik Sedlomancz folded it small and kept it close.
Wendel "Mole" Freddie lent Henrik Sedlomancz a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
